sources.title: Introducing Qwen3-Max-Preview (Instruct)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: official Qwen launch post explicitly identifies Qwen3-Max-Preview (Instruct) and states over 1 trillion parameters. This is a strict lower bound, not a nominal exact 1T count; the post supplies no activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: The exact qwen3-max-preview row explicitly dates release to 2025-09-05. Current text describes thinking and non-thinking support; this is current documentation, not proof of thinking support at initial launch.

sources.title: Model inference pricing
sources.evidence: Complete indexed Qwen-Max pricing table explicitly lists qwen3-max-preview with both Non-Thinking and Thinking modes, distinct from the non-thinking-only qwen3-max-2025-09-23 row.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max-Preview model page
sources.evidence: Complete indexed page for the exact qwen3-max-preview identifier documents text input/output, Function Calling, thinking/non-thinking modes and rounded 262K context. Direct reopening returned HTTP 404; used as historical indexed documentation, not proof of live availability.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max: Just Scale it
sources.evidence: Rechecked October 27, 2026 through indexed primary text; direct reopening still produced no extractable body. The introduction explicitly identifies the preview as a version of Qwen3-Max-Instruct. The Qwen3-Max-Base section states over 1 trillion parameters and identifies MoE architecture. This supports a named-variant MoE inference for the preview; the inspected announcement gives neither a numeric preview total beyond the bound nor activated parameters, and describes no pruning, distillation, expert expansion or modality addition between the named preview and this model.

sources.title: Text generation models
sources.evidence: Indexed September 11, 2026 legacy-model table groups qwen3-max-preview under Qwen3-Max with 256k context and Function Calling. The live October page no longer includes this Qwen3 section; neither representation gives an exact token count for the preview.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max exact model and snapshot specifications
sources.evidence: Parent read the complete indexed primary page, including separately titled qwen3-max-preview and January2026 sections. Both explicitly list262144 context. Preview tables mark Function Calling unsupported across regions; the main alias supports it in Beijing. Direct parser exceeded size limit; current endpoint operation was not tested.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
sources.evidence: October 27 fresh search retrieved the indexed February 2026 primary article and comparison tables; direct canonical-page extraction was empty. The pretraining section still identifies Qwen3-Max-Base only as >1T parameters. The later tables benchmark Qwen3-Max-Thinking but do not provide a Max or Max-Preview activated-parameter column. The explicit 397B total and 17B activated figures apply to the distinct Qwen3.5 model, not this preview.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates: preview and later Max releases
sources.evidence: October 27 fresh indexed primary lifecycle table retains the September 5, 2025 qwen3-max-preview row and separately describes the September 24 official Qwen3-Max release as upgraded from the preview. Neither row discloses total or activated counts. Later qwen3.8-max rows disclose 2.4T with native visual understanding and are distinct releases; that count cannot be transferred to qwen3-max-preview.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official Qwen3-Max-Preview name; launch calls it Instruct.

developer.note: Qwen developer announcement and Alibaba Cloud release history identify the developer and serving platform.

release_date.note: Exact identifier and explicit date in the official release table.

open_weights.note: Primary material establishes hosted Chat/API access. No exact-preview weight release or explicit primary closed-weight declaration was located; API access alone does not prove weights are unavailable. Baseline false is not contradicted.

license.note: No model-weight license was disclosed in the inspected exact-preview announcement or model page; do not copy licenses from open Qwen checkpoints.

parameters_b.note: Developer disclosure for the exact preview is >1000B, confirmed on fresh review; a later primary comparison still gives Qwen3-Max-Base as >1T. Preserve this verified strict lower bound in the proposed lower-bound fields and public notes. The point-value field remains null because no supported nominal point count was located, not because an exact tensor census is required. Later Max generations are distinct models.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-preview announcement, named Max lineage, later Qwen3.5 comparison tables and current lifecycle searches did not locate a developer-published active count for this preview. MoE establishes sparse architecture but supplies no numeric activated count; do not transfer 17B from Qwen3.5, 22B from Qwen3-235B or counts from later Max generations.

architecture.note: Clearly labeled lineage inference: Qwen names the launch model Qwen3-Max-Preview (Instruct), then explicitly identifies it as the preview version of Qwen3-Max-Instruct in the announcement that describes Qwen3-Max-Base as MoE. No structural change defeating that relationship is described in the inspected primary material. This does not infer a numeric expert or active-parameter count.

context_window.note: Exact262144 context appears in the separately named model section of the indexed primary card; no inference from rounded256k.

modalities.note: Historical indexed exact-model page explicitly lists Text input and Text output.

reasoning.note: Current official lifecycle and pricing documentation explicitly supports thinking and non-thinking for this mutable alias. Launch material calls the original preview Instruct, so this flag must not be backdated to imply launch-day thinking support.

tool_call.note: Exact preview-specific regional tables explicitly mark Function Calling unsupported; general family-level feature claims do not override them.

description.value: Hosted preview of Alibaba's Qwen3-Max model, announced with more than one trillion parameters for text generation, instruction following, and agentic tasks.
description.note: Replaces generic flagship wording with the exact preview identity and bounded parameter disclosure; avoids implying this remains Alibaba's current flagship.

patch.description: Hosted preview of Alibaba's Qwen3-Max model, announced with more than one trillion parameters for text generation, instruction following, and agentic tasks.
patch.notes: Qwen disclosed more than 1 trillion total parameters (>1000B) for Preview Instruct; no nominal point total or active count is disclosed. MoE is inferred from the developer’s explicit Qwen3-Max-Instruct preview lineage and Max-Base architecture. The indexed preview card documents 262144 context, thinking/non-thinking support and no native Function Calling. Weight availability remains unverified; later Max generations are separate.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirmed the exact-preview >1000B lower bound, proposed explicit exclusive-bound fields, and found no supported nominal point total or active count in fresh first-party searches and later comparison tables. Both point-value fields remain explicitly null with primary provenance. The explicit named-preview relationship supports a coupled MoE architecture correction. Other field assessments are preserved.
